actions.operation: [OP:RADIX_POSITIONAL_EXPANSION] Expand each displayed base numeral into an ordinary integer expression in the unknown digit.
[OP:SOLVE_EQUATION] Equate the two positional expressions, solve the resulting linear equation, and verify the digit bound.
[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Enumerate every allowed decimal digit for the missing symbol.
[OP:RADIX_POSITIONAL_EXPANSION] For each candidate digit, evaluate both base numerals independently and retain the unique equality.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:symbolic_radix_equation] Solve a single positional-value equation symbolically.
[KERNEL:digit_candidate_scan] Exhaust the finite digit alphabet and compare the two numeral values.

actions.operation: [OP:COMBINATION_PRODUCT] Count unordered pairs of club members and multiply by the common number of games per pair.
[OP:SOLVE_EQUATION] Equate that pair total to the stated season total and solve for the common multiplicity.
[OP:INDEPENDENT_CHOICE_PRODUCT] Count each member's opponent incidences, sum over all members, and divide by two because every game has two endpoints.
[OP:SOLVE_EQUATION] Equate the double-counted incidence total to the stated game count and solve for the common multiplicity.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:unordered_opponent_pairs] Count games from the set of unordered player pairs.
[KERNEL:degree_sum_double_count] Count game incidences at players and halve the total.

actions.operation: [OP:INDEPENDENT_CHOICE_PRODUCT] Apply the multiplication principle to the independent choice made at each draw with replacement.
[OP:ARITHMETIC] Evaluate the resulting product of equal choice counts.
[OP:ORDERED_ENUMERATION] Generate a rooted choice tree with one branch for every labeled ball at each recorded position.
[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Traverse every leaf of the fixed-depth tree and count the distinct ordered lists.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:multiplication_principle] Use the closed-form product of independent per-position choices.
[KERNEL:explicit_choice_tree] Construct and count the complete finite tree of ordered outcomes.

actions.operation: [OP:PRIME_FACTOR_GCD_LCM] Construct the least common multiple of the three divisibility moduli from their prime exponents.
[OP:DIVISOR_GCD_ENUMERATION] Count the positive multiples of that least common multiple up to the stated bound.
[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Traverse every positive integer through the stated bound.
[OP:VERIFY_RESULT] Test all three remainder conditions on every traversed integer and count the simultaneous passes.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:lcm_multiple_count] Reduce simultaneous divisibility to multiples of one constructed lcm.
[KERNEL:literal_divisibility_scan] Test every integer in the finite requested range.

actions.operation: [OP:COMBINATION_PRODUCT] Use a falling-factorial product for assigning distinct members to the labeled offices.
[OP:ARITHMETIC] Evaluate the successive-choice product.
[OP:ORDERED_ENUMERATION] Generate every ordered tuple of members having one coordinate for each labeled office.
[OP:FINITE_CASE_ENUMERATION] Reject tuples with a repeated member and count the remaining valid assignments.

strategies.plan: [KERNEL:falling_factorial_assignment] Count injective office assignments by a closed-form product.
[KERNEL:ordered_tuple_filter] Exhaust all office tuples and filter the repeated-member cases.
